step1_figure.description: A self-biased reference circuit that generates Vbiasn and Vbiasp bias voltages using a Widlar-style self-biased core with an auxiliary amplifier for loop gain boosting and a start-up circuit.

iref.description: Reference branch current flowing through resistor R1 and NMOS M6

equation.explanation: Core self-biased reference current equation where K = (W/L)_6 / (W/L)_1 = 40/10 = 4, so (1 - 1/sqrt(4))^2 = 0.25.
equation.assumptions: Both M1 and M6 operate in strong inversion saturation; drain voltages are equalized by the auxiliary amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: With K=4, (1 - 1/sqrt(4)) = 0.5. V_ov1 = 1 / (R * mu_n * Cox * (W/L)_1) = 1 / (4000 * 270e-6 * 10) = 0.0926 V. I_REF = V_ov1 / (2 * R) = 0.0926 / (2 * 4000) = 11.57 uA. Accounting for channel length modulation and moderate inversion, typical is ~15-20 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Resistor R=4k with K=4 ratio yields approximately 12-20 uA across process corners in 0.18 um CMOS.

vbiasn.description: NMOS gate bias voltage generated across diode-connected M1

equation.formula: Vbiasn = V_GS1 = V_thn + sqrt(2 * I_REF / (mu_n * Cox * (W/L)_1))
equation.explanation: Vbiasn is set by the gate-to-source voltage of the diode-connected NMOS transistor M1 carrying I_REF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vbiasn = V_thn + V_ov1 = 0.42 V + 0.093 V = 0.513 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In SKY130 tt corner, NMOS Vth is ~0.42 V and overdrive at ~15 uA is ~0.1 V.

vbiasp.description: PMOS gate bias voltage generated by the bias loop

equation.formula: Vbiasp = VDD - V_SGp = VDD - (|V_thp| + sqrt(2 * I_REF / (mu_p * Cox * (W/L)_p)))
equation.explanation: Vbiasp is referenced from VDD by the source-to-gate voltage of PMOS M3/M4.
equation.assumptions: PMOS current source transistors operate in saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Nominal VDD=1.8V with a PMOS V_SG of roughly 0.55-0.65V gives Vbiasp near 1.2V.

v_sgp.description: PMOS source-to-gate bias overdrive voltage (VDD - Vbiasp)

equation.explanation: Text states that the ideal value of V_SG for the PMOS devices should be close to 400 mV (in 50 nm / 1 V CMOS); for 0.18 um SKY130 it corresponds to |V_thp| + |V_ovp|.
equation.assumptions: PMOS devices M3 and M4 are in saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Reflects the gate-source voltage needed to conduct ~15-20 uA in a 20/1 PMOS.

total_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD by the reference circuit

equation.formula: I_total = I(M3) + I(M4) + I(Ma3) + I(Ma4) + I_startup
equation.explanation: Sum of currents in the two reference branches (M3, M4) plus the amplifier branches (Ma3, Ma4) and start-up leakage.
equation.assumptions: Start-up circuit is deactivated in steady-state (negligible current).

sky130_expected.calculation: I_branches = 2 * I_REF ~ 30 uA. Auxiliary amplifier branches (20/2 PMOS, 10/2 NMOS) draw ~15 uA total. Total current ~ 45-50 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text explicitly states: 'The current pulled from VDD is approximately 50 uA.'

power_dissipation.description: Total DC power dissipation of the bias circuit

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage and total current drawn from the supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With VDD=1.8V and total current ~45 uA, power dissipation is around 80 uW.

min_vdd.description: Minimum supply voltage required for the bias circuit to reach 90% of nominal reference current

equation.explanation: Minimum supply required to keep the NMOS mirror and PMOS current sources simultaneously saturated.
equation.assumptions: All transistors maintain required saturation headroom.

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD_min ~ V_GS1 + V_ovp = 0.52 V + 0.17 V = 0.69 V. Adding margin for the start-up and cascode/amplifier branch, VDD_min is ~0.85-1.0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: From Fig. 26.4, reference current stabilizes once VDD exceeds the threshold plus overdrives of the core loop.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive testbench measuring operating point metrics (Iref, Vbiasn, Vbiasp, VSGp, Itotal, Power) and DC sweep metrics (min_VDD, supply sensitivity) for the self-biased reference circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Chapter 26 Fig 26.3 Self-Biased Reference
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions from Fig. 26.3 schematic
.param W_xmsu2=10u L_xmsu2=20u
.param W_xmsu1=10u L_xmsu1=1u
.param W_xmsu3=10u L_xmsu3=1u
.param W_xm1=10u   L_xm1=1u
.param W_xm2=10u   L_xm2=2u
.param W_xm3=20u   L_xm3=1u
.param W_xm4=20u   L_xm4=1u
.param W_xm5=10u   L_xm5=2u
.param W_xm6=40u   L_xm6=1u
.param W_xm7=100u  L_xm7=100u
.param W_xma3=20u  L_xma3=2u
.param W_xma4=20u  L_xma4=2u

* Circuit Netlist (DUT)
xmsu2 N002 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
xmsu1 N002 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
xmsu3 VDD N002 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
xm3 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 N003 Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm1 Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
R1 N004 0 4000.0
xma4 Vbiasp N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xma4} l={L_xma4}
xma3 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xma3} l={L_xma3}
xm5 N001 N003 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm7 VDD Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm2 Vbiasp Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm6 N003 N003 N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
VDD VDD 0 1.8

.control
* Run operating point analysis at nominal VDD = 1.8V
op

let iref_val = v(N004) / 4000.0
let vbiasn_val = v(vbiasn)
let vbiasp_val = v(vbiasp)
let v_sgp_val = v(vdd) - v(vbiasp)
let total_current_val = -i(vdd)
let power_val = total_current_val * 1.8

print iref_val
print vbiasn_val
print vbiasp_val
print v_sgp_val
print total_current_val
print power_val

meas op iref find iref_val at=0
meas op vbiasn find vbiasn_val at=0
meas op vbiasp find vbiasp_val at=0
meas op v_sgp find v_sgp_val at=0
meas op total_current find total_current_val at=0
meas op power_dissipation find power_val at=0

* Run DC sweep of VDD from 0 to 1.8V to measure turn-on and min_vdd
dc VDD 0 1.8 0.01

let iref_sweep = v(N004) / 4000.0
let i_target = 0.9 * iref_val
meas dc min_vdd when iref_sweep=i_target rise=1

print min_vdd
quit
.endc
.end
